title: Stop Taking Tokenizers for Granted: They Are Core Design Decisions in Large Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating token length disparities, sequence inflation (e.g., tokens per 1k characters), parity ratios, and morphological alignment across different languages, particularly comparing English-centric tokenizers against morphologically rich and low-resource languages.
Assessing the over-segmentation and vocabulary allocation of identity-related terms and named entities from underrepresented regions to measure unequal representation.
